Finishing murders that became the series' signature.

How Fatalities connects

  • Work: Mortal Kombat (1992) — Mortal Kombat (1992) made fatalities the series' signature finish.
  • Topic: Mortal Kombat — Fatalities are the finishing murders the series is known for.

What is Fatalities?

Fatalities are the finishing moves that close a Mortal Kombat match — spine-rips, hellfire, and ice statues that made the 1992 arcade game infamous.

Key threads lead to Mortal Kombat (1992) and Mortal Kombat.
